title: Canonical transport of complementary frames and positive ordinary Kummer image
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions] and a closed pair $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion] with a framed invertible module $(L,s)$ [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-pur-framed-integral-extension]. Define the restriction of s to a smaller complementary open by the actual frame-torsor sheaf restriction. For an etale morphism $v:T^\prime\to T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the inverse-image closed support, define its pulled frame on the canonical tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Transport the upstream frame pullback of [lem-sc-line-bundle-torsor] through the canonical comparison with Mathlib pullback, uniquely determined by the tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]; this also supplies the inherited invertibility. Transport of frames along line isomorphisms is postcomposition in the Isom torsor. Define the positive ordinary Kummer image to be the actual connecting map of [lem-amb-kummer-any-base] applied to the ordinary frame-torsor class, followed by the root tensor coefficient map of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], with the finite twist convention [def-pur-frame-kummer-class].
